image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of an open comic book page or a collage of comic book panels. The image features vibrant, retro-style illustrations with bold outlines and halftone dot patterns typical of mid-20th-century printing. Visible elements include dynamic character figures (a blue-clad figure in the foreground, a green dragon-like creature, and other heroes/villains in the background), multiple speech bubbles with text, and caption boxes. The composition is dense and colorful, mimicking the aesthetic of classic superhero comics.

artifact_observations.location: Speech bubbles and caption boxes throughout the image
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text within the speech bubbles and captions resembles English letters but is largely nonsensical or illegible upon close inspection (e.g., 'OTCHAO', 'JLZ'). This is a common AI artifact where the model mimics the shape of text without generating coherent language.
The halftone dot patterns are inconsistent; some areas have sharp dots while others blur into noise or solid color, lacking the uniform mechanical precision of real printed comics.

The black lines defining the panel borders become wavy and inconsistent in thickness, and some borders seem to merge incorrectly with the character outlines, suggesting a slight failure in maintaining rigid geometric structures.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the image is correctly classified as a comic book and not just a general illustration or poster.
To rigorously evaluate the legibility and coherence of the text, which is a critical functional component of comics and a known failure point for AI.
To assess the consistency of the halftone textures and identify any subtle blending or melting artifacts in the complex composition.
To check if the panel lines remain continuous and distinct from the artwork, ensuring no topological fusion between frames and content.

focus_areas: Legibility and semantic coherence of text in speech bubbles/captions
Consistency and mechanical regularity of halftone/dot patterns
Integrity and straightness of panel border lines
Distinct separation between characters and background elements
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's output. If the text is gibberish, this is a significant artifact for a 'comic book' class, as text is a defining feature. Also, verify if the halftone patterns look naturally printed or artificially noisy/blurred. Check if panel borders are logically consistent (do they connect properly?).
